purpose: Replay-fixtures gate: committed redacted golden fixtures under spec/evidence/fixtures are replayed offline through the real wrapper helpers (invoiceItemUnitPriceFromWire from wrapper/money.ts and invoiceUpdateBodyFromExisting from wrapper/invoice-body.ts, loaded via tsx) to assert documented Clockify wire shapes (invoice tax/discount x100 read-back, time-off {count,requests} envelope, invoice-item unitPrice /100), re-scanned for secrets/un-redacted IDs, and a source-grep tripwire requires invoiceItemUnitPriceToWire at any future invoice-item/payment-create site. Pure Node, network-free, creds-free.

sourceGrepTripwires.name: invoice-item-unit-price-scale
sourceGrepTripwires.reason: invoice-item unitPrice is minor*100 on the wire, so an unscaled price undercharges by 100x

sourceGrepTripwires.name: invoice-payment-id-recovery
sourceGrepTripwires.reason: the payment POST returns the updated invoice, so the new payment id must be recovered by diffing the payments list around the write
